description: This pie chart, from the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse,” visually represents the distribution of media framing across three distinct years: 2017, 2018, and an unlabeled category represented by a gray slice at the top. The chart is divided into three colored segments, each labeled with its corresponding year and percentage value. The largest segment, colored blue, accounts for 46.0% (46) and is associated with the unlabeled gray category. The second largest segment, colored orange, represents 2018 and constitutes 33.0% (33) of the total. The smallest segment, colored green, corresponds to 2017 and makes up 21.0% (21). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and numerical count, and the chart includes a legend that associates the gray color with the unlabeled category. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the blue segment at the top, followed by the orange segment, and then the green segment.
